stories.title: Sources: Big Ten to bar NFL players from return
stories.summary: The Big Ten is set to pass a rule Tuesday that doesn't allow players to return from the NFL and play for one of its schools, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

stories.title: Study: 25% of NFL players in sample had CTE
stories.summary: A new study published Tuesday by the British Medical Journal showed that at least 25% of NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had CTE.

stories.title: PGA Tour postseason to conclude with match play
stories.summary: The PGA Tour's future postseason will include a Championship Series finale -- a 72-hole, stroke-play tournament that will finalize the points list and determine the seasonlong champion -- followed by match play over two weeks.

stories.title: LeBron, PGA Tour to bring event to Akron in '27
stories.summary: The LeBron James Family Foundation Invitational will be played in James' hometown of Akron, Ohio, in July 2027, James' foundation announced Tuesday.

stories.title: Sources: Vandy's Berlowitz QB1; Curtis will play
stories.summary: Vanderbilt will start Blaze Berlowitz at quarterback in their season opener against Austin Peay, but five-star freshman Jared Curtis is also expected to play, sources tell ESPN.
